name: checklist
title: Checklist
description: A short list of things to do that counts how many are done.
use: Steps the reader ticks off: the steps of a setup, the points of a review. Each step is a native checkbox in a label with a title and a line of help. The checklist has no surface of its own; put it in a card.

instead.when: The system completes the steps and the reader only follows them
The rows have nothing to check
The checkboxes are options of a form, not things to do
The items are read, not ticked off

keyboard.action: Checks or clears the focused step, as the native checkbox does

classes.name: checklist
classes.description: The list, on a ul, or an ol when the steps are done in order; it counts its steps and the checked ones

classes.name: checklist-item
classes.description: A step, on the li; it counts itself, and counts itself done while its checkbox is checked

classes.name: checklist-label
classes.description: The label: the checkbox, then the words. The whole row checks the box

classes.name: checklist-body
classes.description: The words of a step: a title over a description

classes.name: checklist-title
classes.description: The step's name, on an inline element; a hairline is drawn through it when the step is done

classes.name: checklist-description
classes.description: A muted line of help under the title

classes.name: checklist-end
classes.description: Something at the end of a step: a link, a badge, a time

classes.name: checklist-count
classes.description: Steps done and steps in all, written before its own text; it comes after the last step in the markup

states.name: done
states.description: On the checkbox inside: the title turns to muted ink with a hairline through it, and the count goes up by one

states.name: disabled
states.description: On the checkbox inside: the title takes disabled ink

properties.name: --checklist-of
properties.description: What stands between the two numbers of the count

properties.name: --checklist-gap
properties.description: Space between the checkbox and the words

example: • steps done
